still_usable_note: Microsoft states that extended access ended on August 31, 2025 and Azure AD Graph is fully retired.
summary: Azure AD Graph completed retirement on August 31, 2025 after an extended-access period. Microsoft directs integrations to Microsoft Graph.
current_state: Fully retired according to current Microsoft migration documentation; Microsoft Graph is the supported replacement surface.
known_unknowns: The repository does not currently pin the exact calendar date of Microsoft's first 2019 deprecation announcement, so only the year is retained in narrative context and the structured announced_at field remains unknown.
notes: Corrects the older display state that treated August 31, 2026 as an upcoming boundary.
